input.name: dogfood
input.args: {"task":{"medium":"drive","prompt":"Start a desktop substrate, render a clearly recognisable colored shape, and exercise `capture_frame` three ways. First capture with `save_path` but no size arguments and compare the returned inline PNG dimensions with the saved original. Second capture with `scale: 0.5`, `max_dimension: 256`, and `include_image: true`. Third capture with a `not_all_black` check and no `include_image`. Report each returned image block’s dimensions and encoded byte size, the saved PNG dimensions, the checks verdict, and whether the checks call returned an image block.","surfaceUnderTest":"`capture_frame`’s `scale`, `max_dimension`, and `include_image` arguments; the default 768-pixel long-edge ceiling; the checks-driven verdict-only default; and preservation of the full-resolution `save_path` artifact.","expectedArtifact":"the default and explicitly reduced inline PNGs both visibly contain the same recognisable shape, with long edges at most 768 and 256 pixels respectively; the saved PNG retains the desktop frame’s original dimensions; and the checks capture returns a passing verdict text block with no image block."}}
